messages.subject: Regular Expresions - R - Google Analytics
parts:
Hi all.

I am not sure where to post this doubt. But I am facing a problem a cannot solve and I am a bit lost. 

I am using RGoogleAnalytics in order to retrieve data from Analytics. 

When I try to apply the following filter, I get no results from the query

ga:pagePath=~/(a|b|c|d)/../[^/]+/[^/]*$',

However if I use the exact same filter in Analytics query explorer I get results. Meaning that the regular expression is ok.

I know that the problem is coming with some of the special characters. (  ^  or [] ) . 

I really appreciate if someone can helps.

Thanks!

messages.author: 2674b6f8d9871f58
messages.subject: Re: Regular Expresions - R - Google Analytics
parts:
RGoogleAnalytics is no longer maintained (last update August 2014). I don't recall what particular problem I had that made me move away from it, but suffice it to say that it doesn't work very well any more.

As an alternative, I recommend RGA, for which the code is available on GitHub as well as on CRAN, and the developer is very active and responsive.
